name: Lorraine Kim
title: Product Designer
summary: Product designer for complex financial workflows, with fifteen years in institutional finance: buy-side trading operations and supporting asset managers on Bloomberg’s order management system. I research, design and build in code, and test with real users and data.

projects.name: FXpress
projects.desc: Exchange-rate widget for people who send money abroad
bullets: Designed and built a widget that shows where today’s rate sits in its 30-day range across 18 currency pairs, then links to the sender’s own provider.
Interviewed 4 senders and tested with 5. All 5 completed the send flow; I fixed the button hierarchy and the threshold field where testers got stuck.
Kept every calculation in code and limited the AI assistant to rewording a sentence the code had written, with a check that rejects advice or a changed meaning.
Found in live logs that the 30-day comparison read “low” 68 of 75 times during a steady trend, and revised the copy.

projects.name: ReconLayer
projects.desc: Reconciliation add-on for small middle-office teams
bullets: Designed and built a Google Sheets add-on that compares internal and broker files, classifies breaks with fixed rules, and drafts counterparty emails for the analyst to review.
Interviewed 5 practitioners at 4 buy-side firms and tested with 5 operators: 4 finished, rating ease 4.75 of 5.
Showed missing trades separately from value differences so they don’t sink to the bottom of a ranked list.
Revised the email prompt three times to stop the model guessing at the cause of each break.

projects.name: Hwang Yoo-Yup Archive
projects.desc: Website for a Korean modernist painter’s estate
bullets: Designed the information architecture, visual system and curatorial copy, and built the site in Framer: a thematic path for newcomers and an archive mode for researchers, in one site the estate can maintain.
Research, design and build financial tools and client websites, prototyping in code with Claude Code and Cursor. Build Figma component libraries, variables and design tokens.
Supported buy-side clients on Bloomberg AIM, diagnosed trading-workflow issues, and tracked fixes with Product and Engineering in Jira.
Turned recurring client issues into product requests that were adopted into AIM.
Re-engineered reconciliation processes for an $8B AUM multi-strategy platform, cutting operational cycle time by 25%. Owned requirements through UAT for system upgrades.
Managed post-trade settlement and cash forecasting across equities, fixed income, futures, FX and swaps.
Managed FX-derivative hedging and risk analytics for institutional equity portfolios.

skills: User research, usability testing, workflow mapping, information architecture, interaction design, prototyping
Figma, components and variants, variables, design tokens, responsive design
AI interaction patterns, prompt design, Claude API, Gemini API, Google Apps Script, Claude Code, Cursor, Vercel, Netlify
